guesses.reason: Small size, large erect triangular ears, rounded apple-ish skull and fine-boned legs strongly suggest Chihuahua ancestry.
The short slightly blunt muzzle, white chest blaze and white paws point toward Boston Terrier or similar bully-type influence.
The dark brindle coat and broad bat-like ears are classic French Bulldog traits, hinting at a Frenchie mix.
